en.summary: Vaginal bleeding before 24 weeks may be a miscarriage and needs maternity assessment. NHS urgent help for light bleeding/spotting or unusual discharge/fluid leak. Emergency (call services) for severe tummy pain, shoulder pain, feeling sick/faint/dizzy/unconscious, or heavy bleeding soaking a pad quickly. Management options are clinical — never invent medicines or procedures here. Overlaps with ectopic/pregnancy-bleeding red-flag entries when severe.
emergencyIf: Pregnant with vaginal bleeding and severe tummy pain
Feeling sick, faint, dizzy or losing consciousness
Heavy bleeding soaking a period pad soon after putting it on
seeDoctorIf: Unusual vaginal discharge or fluid leaking while pregnant
doNot: Do not invent miscarriage medicines or dosing
Do not wait at home with severe pain or heavy bleeding

fr.summary: Un saignement avant 24 SA peut être une fausse couche — avis maternité. Urgence si douleur sévère, douleur d'épaule, malaise/syncope, saignement abondant. Pas de médicaments inventés.
emergencyIf: Saignement abondant saturant une protection rapidement
doNot: Pas de médicaments de fausse couche inventés

he.summary: דימום לפני שבוע 24 עלול להיות הפלה — ייעוץ יולדות. חירום בכאב חזק, כאב כתף, סחרחורת/התעלפות, דימום כבד. אין תרופות מומצאות.

ru.summary: Кровотечение до 24 недель может быть выкидышем — к акушерам. Неотложка при сильной боли, боли в плече, обмороке, обильном кровотечении. Лекарства не выдумывать.
